notes.title: Early June Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added new home room to an early game map.
[*]Adjusted several rooms to remedy possible cheese solutions.
[*]Temporarily removed randomised jump scare sound effect from a late game world.
[*]Missed Heavy Attack (Guardian Ability) no longer ends turn.
[*]Improved clarity of demonic-whistle-watch display.
[*]Other things
[/list]
